title: im new and stuck looking for some help

comments.author: turk-fx
comments.body:

If you dont know what to tell AI to do certain thing, you cant do anything. I am wibe coder and coming from Engineering bacmground and worked as a programmer. Making AI trading bot, but I know software engineering fundemantels, I know math, statistic, engineering, system design. I am also working as a network security engineer. I have no idea about advance trading practices/industry standards. If I didnt have my engineering background, I woulsnt be able to do this. Even with this, slow moving project compared to other things I finished in a day. Go learn about stock markwt, trading, sofware engineering fundamentals, system deaign principle etc... You dont need to be pro on all of these, but have enough background to ask right questions and tell the model correct prompt to get the good result. 

Same principle of the life applies here: Garbage in, garbage out...

comments.author: RemoraEdge
comments.body:
Ai training bots? Or trading bots. I’m assuming trading bots.

To create a trading bot you should already know how to trade or have a profitable strategy that is mechanical. Even discretionary systems need to be broken down into repeatable systems that you can actually code.

Or if you want an AI to trade for you and not write an actual algo, then that’s different. You will still need to teach it a profitable, repeatable, rules based system. And you’ll need to spend money if you want it actually trading for you and watching the markets. The usage can add up if you are going this route and even then it’s very risky. AI can be very forgetful and start doing things you don’t want it to do. It’s not the same as programming an actual algo to trade for you.

comments.author: Ok_Doughnut_189
comments.body: Are you wanting guidance in learning to trade or learning to code an AI trading bot . I’ve personally been making my own AI trading OS for the last six months decent progress, but still far from an expert but I can say most of what I’ve learned has been from me wanting to seek out specific information from trying to understand what the AI was talking about it’s a test intro type of learning experience, but I would better develop my project to understand itself and it’s goal I would connect linear and notion and GitHub to get everything integrated as one I would work on developing a memory base for LLMs that I use to read or update before any operation so we are all on the same page. And I would use ChatGPT on the highest setting on the browser to help formulate my idea then execute correctly. Next area would be to gain some visibility into your project. It’s to create ways for you to see the progress, depending on how big of a project it is. Apart from that creativity and patience.

replies.body: i can trade I'm not the best in the world but I'm definitely not a novice.
